sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Srinidhi G.L..

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 04-05- 2022 and at the time of marriage, the accused have demanded and taken 100 gms. of gold ornaments, Rs.Five lakhs cash, 300 gms. of gold ornaments for CW-1 and 1.5 kg.
Silver articles as dowry from the complainant and her family.
After the marriage, the accused have subjected CW - 1 to mental and physical cruelty by harassing her for giving birth to a female child and did not take care of CW-1 and her child.

The accused have demanded 45 gms. of gold necklace, diamond necklace worth Rs.1,70,000/-, 20 gms. of gold bangles from CW 2 and 3 at the time of Naming Ceremony of the child, abused CW-1 in filthy language.

When CW-1 asked accused as to why using 3-4 Sim cards, the accused has assaulted CW-1 with hands, abused her in filthy language, harassed her to get  3  C.C.No.13241/2025 additional dowry from her maternal house.
When CW-1 asked to hand over all the documents of the child, accused have abused her and assaulted her and also gave life threat to her and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.119/2024 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. Basavanagudi Women south P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court took Smt Srinidhi Gm vs Lokesh Kumar Gm on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5317292/
2 cognizance of the alleged offences.

The plea of the accused  4  C.C.No.13241/2025 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
As there were no any incriminating circumstances in the evidence against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.

I have Perused the materials on record.

 & Sec.3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 5  C.C.No.13241/2025  REASONS  9.
POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
Ex . P.3
is further statement.
10 . CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Srinidhi G.L.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 04-05-2022 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.

PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the  6 Smt Srinidhi Gm vs Lokesh Kumar Gm on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5317292/
4  C.C.No.13241/2025 contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.

sentences.text: The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 7  C.C.No.13241/2025  ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323,504, 506 of IPC. & Sec.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
